terms.name: customer
terms.definition: A person who has purchased at least one item. One row per customer.

terms.name: location
terms.definition: A store, named by city, with an open date and tax rate. One row per store.

terms.name: product
terms.definition: An SKU sold in stores. One row per product. product_type is jaffle or beverage.

terms.name: supply
terms.definition: A supply used for one product. Grain is one supply and product combination.

terms.name: order
terms.definition: One purchase placed by a customer at a store. One row per order.

terms.name: order_item
terms.definition: One line on an order, for one product. One row per order item.

terms.name: calendar_day
terms.definition: One calendar date used to group events. Not a record of a business event.

constraints.text: Analyze from main marts. raw.* money columns are integer cents. Dollar amounts on main.orders (subtotal, tax_paid, order_total) are those cents divided by 100. Do not map terms onto raw.* or main.stg_*.
main.products.product_type is only jaffle or beverage. is_food_item is true exactly when product_type is jaffle. is_drink_item is true exactly when product_type is beverage.
main.customers.customer_type is only new or returning. new means count_lifetime_orders = 1. It is a status computed from orders, not a kind of person.
main.order_items.supply_cost and main.orders.order_cost already sum supplies for the product. Do not add them again to main.supplies.supply_cost.
main.metricflow_time_spine.date_day is a calendar from 2000-01-01 through 2029-12-31, not a table of business events.
